additions.group: 計算光学・単一画素測定列からの直接セグメンテーション
additions.reason_selected: Independent bi-GRU, adaptive cross-attention lift, U-Net++ and task-prioritized reconstruction training; coded measurements to masks rather than input-image masks or restored intensities. Preserve Carvana simulation and MNIST optical-bench checkpoints, not every seed.
additions.quality_positive: Author reports +3.2–9.9 percentage points foreground mIoU over prior image-free baseline on three simulated datasets at 3.13% sampling; optical bench proof of concept.
additions.quality_negative: Clean reconstruct-then-segment wins noiseless; fixed 128x128 / 512 natural-order Hadamard measurements, no independent replication or generalization proof; real capture data not distributed; no optimizer/scheduler.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Lawful instrument research only; not clinical or safety critical. KEEP DGNO fluorescence restoration, SAM3 image segmentation, stereo disparity, TerraFM and PULSE: different tasks. CC BY 4.0 model tag; MIT code; data and owner rights unresolved. KEEP concurrent TATR table geometry, distinct document-image task.
additions.observed_access: public ungated HF API; no owner permission claim
additions.license_metadata: CC-BY-4.0 weights; MIT code; dataset rights separate
